image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a silver Apple iPod Classic resting on a light-colored wooden surface. The device features a brushed metal casing and a glossy black front face with a color LCD screen displaying a music interface (blue header, white list). Below the screen is the iconic circular click wheel. A white cable is plugged into the top left side. The background is out of focus, showing blurred office or desk items.
